narr: Multiple rounds of thunderstorms and showers produced rain amounts of 3 to 5 inches across north Alabama. The heaviest rains were in northwest Alabama around the Quad Cities/Shoals area, and south of the Tennessee River, mainly along and east of the I-65 corridor. This resulted in numerous reports of flash flooding, particularly in the Shoals of northwest Alabama and Cullman County. The flooding prompted the closure of many roads and schools affected by the flooding. The thunderstorms came in multiple waves, one during early morning, another around Midday, with two final waves during the evening hours. Although the majority of severe weather this day occurred south of north Alabama, one EF-1 tornado tracked across northeast Cullman County during the evening hours.
